title: Towards Edge Artificial Intelligence for Predicting Antimicrobial Resistance in Mycobacterium tuberculosis
abstract: arXiv:2611.29143v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in Mycobacterium tuberculosis (MTB) poses a major challenge to global tuberculosis control, as multidrug-resistant strains limit available treatment options. Rapid and accurate prediction of drug resistance from genomic data could support timely treatment decisions and public health interventions. However, many existing computational approaches for genomic AMR prediction rely on computationally intensive pipelines, limiting their suitability for deployment on resource-constrained edge devices. This limitation is particularly relevant in hospital settings in low- and middle-income countries, where computing infrastructure and access to high-performance computational resources may be limited. To address this challenge, we present a lightweight, novel machine learning (ML) approach suitable for running on edge devices that combines 4-mer frequency features derived from whole-genome sequences with a Random Fore

translated_title: 迈向边缘人工智能：预测结核分枝杆菌的抗菌药物耐药性
translated_abstract: 结核分枝杆菌（MTB）的抗菌药物耐药性（AMR）对全球结核病防控构成重大挑战，多重耐药菌株限制了可用的治疗选择。从基因组数据中快速、准确地预测耐药性可以支持及时的治疗决策和公共卫生干预。然而，许多现有的基因组AMR预测计算方法依赖于计算密集型的流程，限制了其在资源受限的边缘设备上部署的适用性。这一局限性在中低收入国家的医院环境中尤为突出，因为这些地区的计算基础设施和高性能计算资源可能较为有限。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种轻量级的新型机器学习（ML）方法，适合在边缘设备上运行，该方法将源自全基因组序列的4-mer频率特征与随机森林相结合。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种轻量级机器学习方法，通过结合全基因组序列的4-mer频率特征与随机森林模型，实现了可在资源受限的边缘设备上运行的结核分枝杆菌抗菌药物耐药性预测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a lightweight machine learning approach that combines 4-mer frequency features from whole-genome sequences with Random Forest, enabling antimicrobial resistance prediction in Mycobacterium tuberculosis on resource-constrained edge devices.
